svg.text: Core battle · Tickets → deck → queue → result
Module 02 · Sheet 1/2 · 10 states in this module · 390 × 844 mobile frames
One ticket is reserved in queue and consumed when the match starts. Queue cancel/timeout releases it; match loss consumes it; server-cancelled matches refund once.
Numbered controls match the route rail beside each phone. Arrows lead to destination screen IDs. Dashed paths are system outcomes, not player buttons.
Hub prioritizes one battle CTA, chest queue and live event. Wallet + routes open contextual resource
Tickets apply to ranked and event battles

Match ends: victory → B06 / Match ends: defeat → B07 / Connection lost → R02
